services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Host your event inside the Galveston Railroad Museum’s historic 1932 Union Station, outdoor courtyard, or vintage railcars. Spaces are available for weddings, birthday parties, meetings, dinners and private celebrations with capacities ranging from 20 to 350 guests. A uniquely beautiful and highly photogenic venue for special occasions, the Galveston Railroad Museum is accommodating and affordable for weddings of all sizes. For vows or receptions, the facility can accommodate up to 350 guests either outdoors or in the beautifully restored 1932 Union Station train depot. services.name: Young Ingenuity Program
services.desc: The pilot program was initiated in 2022 when a student approached the museum about the possibility of tackling the restoration of a train track signal that he saw sitting dormant on the railyard. Acting as mentor, his father supervised the project, and the museum provided the materials and tools. The signal was completely restored and placed in the train depot as an interactive display. Another project soon followed and the museum adopted the educational outreach as the Young Ingenuity Program.
